correctness.rationale: All 12 primitive fields, 208 nonempty gradient-field faces, and 592 Hasse covers are reconstructed from the graph. The 101-pair matching is globally acyclic and leaves exactly one 0-cell and five 3-cells, yielding a wedge of five 3-spheres. The exact Laplacian determinant and boundary ranks over three prime fields independently check the face counts and Betti vector.
